content: 1. What is your occupation? Please specify your job or profession. 2. How old are you? (Example: 60 years old) 3. What is your gender? Please select one: Male, Female, or Prefer not to disclose. Work Time and Duration 4. How many hours per day do you work? Sleepiness 5. Have you been diagnosed with a sleeping disorder? 6. How likely are you to doze off or fall asleep in the following situations? Please rate each on a scale of 0 to 3, where 0 means would never doze and 3 means high chance of dozing: Sitting and reading. Watching television. Sitting inactive in a public place (e.g., a theater or a meeting). As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break. Lying down to rest in the afternoon when circumstances permit. Sitting and talking to someone. Sitting quietly after lunch without alcohol. In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic. 7. What was your total score for the above situations? Please select one: 0-10, 10-12, or 12-24. 8. How many near-miss accidents have you experienced in the past month? Please select one: 0, 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, or more than 6. 9. How many times did you feel sleepy while driving during the past month? Please select the time of day when this occurred most frequently: 5 AM-10 AM, 10 AM-3 PM, 3 PM-8 PM, 8 PM-12 AM, or 12 AM-5 AM. 10. In the past month, how many times did you have to stop your car because of sleepiness while driving? Please select one: 0, 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, or more than 6. 11. What was the primary cause of your drowsiness during the past month? Please select one: Sleep deprivation, Medications, Sleep disorder, or Other. Brief Medical History 12. Do you take any medications that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No. 13. Have you been diagnosed with any medical illness that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No.
